title: 3-Way / 4-Way Generic Scenario Compare
primary_user_story: As a user, I can create Generic Base, Downside, Upside and optional Custom scenarios, then see all key KPIs side-by-side instead of comparing only two scenarios at a time.
scope: Generic exploratory path only. TUHO / Oborovo factory paths preserved.

helper.name: compare_multi_scenarios
helper.purpose: Pure read-only helper: returns comparison matrix for 2-4 saved scenarios, with deltas vs Base (first scenario).
returns_none_for: any scenario_id that cannot be resolved for the user

route.soft_error_semantics: all error states return 200 with a clear message instead of 500

ui.notes: Multi-compare table + EXPLORATORY banner + scenario chips + governance rows; uses bracket access row['values'] to avoid Jinja2 dict.values() confusion
Conditional include of scenario_compare_multi.html at the bottom when multi_compare_result or multi_compare_error is set

notes: _render_scenario_workspace() extended with 3 optional kwargs: multi_compare_result, multi_compare_error, multi_compare_parsed_ids

blocks.name: Helper (Pure Unit)
covers: rejection of too-few, too-many, duplicates, unresolved
returns dict shape (scenarios, base_scenario_id, metrics, governance_rows)
metrics have parallel values[] + deltas[] + sign_classes[]
base column has delta=0 + sign_class=zero (or n/a if base missing)
all sign_classes in {pos, neg, zero, na}

blocks.name: Route (GET /scenarios/compare-multi)
covers: empty / 1 / 5+ / duplicates / unresolved -> 200 with clear error message

blocks.name: UI Template
covers: metric table + head row + Deltas vs Base column

blocks.name: Safety Constraints
covers: no factory leakage in helper output
no rc1 in route or helper code
no new financial formulas (.irr(, npv(, numpy, pandas, atad_*, corporate_rate)
no construction flag flips in diff

blocks.name: End-to-End Integration
covers: 4 scenarios produce 1 base + 3 variant chips + 3 'vs' separators
route is read-only (updated_at and last_run_summary unchanged)
empty last_run_summary + empty governance_state does not crash

blocks.name: CSS Style Guard
covers: no Tailwind @apply or Alpine x-data in the multi-compare CSS block

before_25B2: Open three separate 2-way compares or copy numbers into a spreadsheet.
after_25B2: See single table with 10 metrics x N scenarios + deltas vs Base
EXPLORATORY banner visible if project is generic_solar / generic_wind
Governance rows (G20 + R99/R102) at the bottom

what_is_NOT_in_this_phase: No percentage deltas (deferred; absolute deltas are the meaningful ones for IRR metrics)
No Min DSCR as a separate row (Avg DSCR used to match the existing pair-compare convention)
No interactive selection UI (route accepts scenario_ids as query string; checkbox UI is follow-up)
No model re-execution (compare only reads existing last_run_summary values)
No historical compare (only current saved snapshot of each scenario)
No link from the existing Compare workspace tab (small follow-up)
recommended_next_phase: 25B-3 ('What changed' delta indicator) or 25B-4 (auto-save on dirty). Or a 25B-2.1 follow-up: 'Open Multi-Compare' button in the existing Compare workspace tab.
next_step: Open DRAFT PR (no merge); do not mark ready; stop after report
